newsitem.title: USA: Gusto-Transmedia Network merger talks end.
newsitem.headline: Gusto-Transmedia Network merger talks end.

text.p: Gusto Marketing Services said Monday its merger talks with Transmedia Networks Inc have been terminated.
Company president and chief executive officer Vic Bubnow said, "We were unable to reach terms that were in the best interests of our cardholders, merchants and shareholders."

Gusto Marketing operates a discount-dining card business in five markets in Florida, Minnesota, North Carolina and South Carolina through strategic partnerships with Knight-Ridder Inc newspapers, it said. It is 19-percent owned by Knight-Ridder.
